dinner.name: Moroccan Chicken Tagine (Braised Chicken with Preserved Lemons and Olives)
dinner.description: Braised chicken with preserved lemons and olives - Moroccan dinner classic
instructions: Season chicken with salt and pepper
Heat olive oil in tagine pot or large heavy-bottomed skillet over medium-high heat
Brown chicken on all sides (8-10 minutes total); remove and set aside
Reduce heat to medium; add onions, cook until softened (5 minutes)
Add garlic and minced ginger; cook 1 minute
Add turmeric, cumin, ginger powder, paprika, cinnamon; cook 2 minutes until fragrant
Add preserved lemon, olives, saffron, cilantro, parsley
Cover and simmer on low heat 40-50 minutes until chicken is very tender
Serve over couscous or with bread for soaking sauce
dinner.notes: Preserved lemons (or noomi) are signature Moroccan ingredient where lemons are cured in salt for weeks
dinner.fun_fact: Preserved lemons create an earthy complexity impossible to replicate with fresh lemon juice
